policy: Core rankings use captured benchmark-maintainer evaluations only. Provider reports and republications are kept in a separate comparison ranked only within its source report when a better direction is verified. Selected-model comparison plots reproduce a single source table ordered by score within that report when a better direction is verified; descriptive or unverified-direction measures retain source order without ranks. Competitor columns remain publisher comparisons, not competitor self-reports. Missing values and incompatible or conflicted columns are listed separately; official rankings remain separate.
